title: ID0444000-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R4 170001715] Power Increment Required
description:
Reported Behavior/ Issue: Power Increment Required
Solution: Increase "Input power limitation" to 180kVA and DC1/DC2 "Maximum Power" to 160kW

additional_info.subject: Error Description
additional_info.body:
Bitte die max. Leistung auf 160 kW hochsetzen. Danke
Please increase the maximum power to 160 kW. Thank you.
